title: Introduction to CryptoHack
summary: A practical introduction to encodings, XOR, byte operations, and the foundational techniques used throughout CryptoHack.

title: Easy1
summary: Solving a Vigenère cipher challenge by identifying the cipher structure and applying the supplied key correctly.

title: ECB Oracle
summary: A byte-at-a-time ECB oracle attack demonstrating how deterministic block encryption can disclose an appended secret.

title: Lazy CBC
summary: Recovering an AES key by exploiting CBC key-and-IV reuse together with plaintext disclosed through an error response.

title: Many Time Secrets
summary: Investigating reused one-time-pad keystreams with XOR relationships, crib dragging, and partial plaintext recovery.

title: Mind Your Ps and Qs
summary: Breaking weak RSA by factoring the public modulus, rebuilding the private key, and decrypting the supplied ciphertext.

title: Dancing Queen
summary: Tracing stream-cipher behavior and byte-level transformations to recover the challenge secret with a reproducible script.

title: Sakura
summary: Following a multi-stage public-information trail through usernames, GitHub, PGP data, cryptocurrency activity, Wi-Fi clues, and travel evidence.

title: KaffeeSec SomeINT
summary: Correlating public profiles and platform clues while documenting how automated reconnaissance supports manual verification.

title: Cache Me Outside
summary: An OSINT investigation built around cached public activity, identity clues, and evidence gathered across multiple platforms.

title: Matryoshka Dolls
summary: Extracting recursively embedded files from an image and validating each layer until the hidden evidence is recovered.

title: tunn3l v1s10n
summary: Repairing a malformed BMP header byte by byte, calculating the correct dimensions, and revealing concealed image data.

title: Carnage
summary: Investigating a packet capture with Wireshark to reconstruct suspicious traffic, extract indicators, and follow the compromise timeline.

title: Sleuthkit Apprentice
summary: Examining a disk image with Sleuth Kit utilities to locate partitions, enumerate files, and recover the target artifact.

title: Permissions
summary: Enumerating a Linux host and abusing an overly permissive sudo rule to reach protected data through an authorized binary.

title: Linux Privilege Escalation
summary: A broad Linux privilege-escalation lab covering enumeration, weak permissions, scheduled tasks, capabilities, NFS, and multiple paths to root.

title: RootMe
summary: A complete web-to-root path using service enumeration, directory discovery, upload-filter bypass, shell access, and Linux privilege escalation.

title: Power Cookie
summary: Inspecting and modifying client-side cookie state to demonstrate why authorization decisions cannot be trusted to the browser.

title: SQLiLite
summary: Tracing a vulnerable authentication query and constructing a controlled SQL injection to bypass the login check.

title: n0s4n1ty 1
summary: Turning weak profile-image upload validation into server-side code execution and controlled file access.

title: Noted
summary: Analyzing stored XSS, browser state, and a report workflow to understand how attacker-controlled content reaches a privileged session.

title: JaWT Scratchpad
summary: Recovering a weak JWT signing secret and forging an authorized token to access protected application functionality.

title: buffer overflow 0
summary: A first stack-overflow exercise showing how oversized input reaches a crash handler and triggers the challenge win condition.

title: Buffer Overflow 1
summary: Calculating a stack offset, controlling EIP, and redirecting execution to an existing win function in a vulnerable binary.

title: PIE TIME
summary: Using a leaked runtime address and symbol offsets to calculate the randomized location of a target function in a PIE binary.

title: ret2win x86_64
summary: Finding the exact overflow offset and building a minimal ROP chain that redirects execution to the supplied win function.

title: split x86_64
summary: Building a ROP chain from existing gadgets, a useful command string, and a PLT function to read the challenge flag.

title: GDB Test Drive
summary: Using GDB to inspect program behavior, bypass an unnecessary delay, and reveal the flag-producing execution path.

title: Packer
summary: Identifying a UPX-packed binary, unpacking it, and examining the recovered program to locate the embedded secret.

title: FactCheck
summary: Combining Ghidra and GDB to trace a quiet binary as it reconstructs its flag through runtime string operations.
